title: The Venom Weaving Course
summary: A course in spinning venom qi into threads and needles and weaving them into lines and cages that bind and sting.

title: A Course in Poisoned Strikes
summary: A course in palms and elbows and heels that carry toxin into a blow and drive it deep into the limb.

title: The Second Primer of Toxic Veils
summary: A second primer for students who hold the basics of poison mist; it builds veils and clouds that blind and choke and burst.

title: A Course in Purging
summary: A course in driving poison out of a body: pushing it through the skin and drawing it from the blood of an ally.

title: The Viper Form Course
summary: A course in the low coiled stances of the snake that strike fast and slip away and flare a hood to unsettle the foe.

title: The Blightroot Course
summary: A course that grows poison as a plant grows: roots that hold the foot leaves that guard and blooms that scorch the air.

title: A Course in Wasting Draughts
summary: A course in poisons that drain strength and breath and in the matching draughts that restore a poisoned friend.
